name: What is a detached ADU?
description: A detached ADU is a separate, self-contained living unit built on the same property as a main house, with its own kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area.

acceptedAnswer.text: A detached Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit built as a separate, standalone structure on the same property as a primary residence. It includes its own kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area, functioning as an independent living space. Detached ADUs offer privacy and can be used for various purposes, such as housing extended family, generating rental income, or providing a dedicated home office or studio.
